Hey Coaches, it is with great honour that I introduce our next presenter in Carl Mays. Carl spent six years at the LTA as the head of women's tennis and prior to that was the coach of world number one, Kim Kleister's for ten years. Currently Carl is at the Soto Tennis Academy in Spain where he is working with WTA player Tamara Corpatch who made the round of 32 at last year's Australian Open. Today he joins us to share some of his insights into the women's game and some of the common trends. Carl, welcome. Hello everyone and welcome to my presentation for the virtual conference for Tennis Australia in 2023. I'll talk you through a number of case studies, experiences of my coaching career and how I prepared players, pro players to compete on the tour, mainly the WTA tour.
